# Sample Regulation

This is a synthetic regulatory document used for unit tests of the
chunker and Markdown parser.

## 1. Capital Requirements

UK firms must hold capital sufficient to cover their risks.

### 1.1 Tier 1

Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital comprises ordinary shares and
retained earnings.

### 1.2 Tier 2

Tier 2 capital includes subordinated debt with a minimum maturity.

## 2. Liquidity

Firms shall maintain a Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) of at least 100%.
